# McKinney Realty

> Father-and-son multi-family and investment real estate team serving all of
> Ontario. Apartment buildings and investment properties, $2M–$10M, with
> particular depth in Ontario's secondary markets. $200M+ combined career
> transaction volume; $100M+ in multi-family, land, and commercial.
> Sean McKinney, Broker of Record, RE/MAX Quinte Ltd., Brokerage.
> Liam McKinney, Broker, Property.ca Inc., Brokerage.
